I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread: the ticket for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, with the import file attached. Tobias is in #central-team, and a ticket number isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share. I also pointed out the open problem on that ticket: the file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, and Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimports so there are no duplicates.

I found the conversation in GBrain and checked it against the #central-team history I had already read.
